mapper.select: SELECT tenant_nm, business_registration_number, business_type, business_category, president_name, post_code, address, telephone_no, facsimile_no, stamp_image FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND use_at = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_tenant SET tenant_nm = #{companyName}, business_registration_number = NULLIF(#{businessNo}, ''), business_type = NULLIF(#{businessType}, ''), business_category = NULLIF(#{businessCategory}, ''), president_name = NULLIF(#{presidentName}, ''), post_code = NULLIF(#{postCode}, ''), address = NULLIF(#{address}, ''), telephone_no = NULLIF(#{telephoneNo}, ''), facsimile_no = NULLIF(#{facsimileNo}, ''), stamp_image = NULLIF(#{stampImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND use_at = 'Y'
